title: Ceramic Blue Tile
description: Premium ceramic tile with glossy blue finish designed for modern interiors. It offers a smooth surface, long-lasting durability, and is perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, and stylish wall decoration.

title: Marble White Tile
description: Elegant white marble tile crafted for luxury interiors with a polished surface and natural stone texture. Ideal for premium flooring and wall designs in modern homes and commercial spaces.

title: Granite Black Tile
description: Durable granite tile with a polished black surface offering strong resistance against scratches and heavy usage. Perfect for high-traffic areas and modern architectural designs.

title: Wooden Texture Tile
description: Wood-look porcelain tile that combines natural wood aesthetics with the strength of ceramic. Ideal for creating warm, cozy, and modern interior spaces.

title: Bathroom Mosaic Tile
description: Small mosaic glass tiles specially designed for bathrooms and wet areas. They provide excellent water resistance, stylish patterns, and easy maintenance.

title: Outdoor Stone Tile
description: Rough natural stone tile designed for outdoor environments. It provides high durability, weather resistance, and a natural rustic look for patios and gardens.

title: Glossy Red Tile
description: Bright red glossy ceramic tile designed for modern kitchens and accent walls. It adds a bold and vibrant look with a smooth reflective finish.

title: Concrete Finish Tile
description: Industrial-style concrete finish tile with a modern minimalist design. Ideal for lofts, offices, and contemporary architectural spaces.

title: Patterned Vintage Tile
description: Classic vintage-style decorative tile with artistic patterns. Perfect for adding a traditional and aesthetic touch to floors and walls.

title: Luxury Gold Vein Tile
description: Premium marble tile with elegant gold vein patterns. Designed for luxury interiors, hotels, and high-end architectural projects.

title: Matte Grey Tile
description: Minimalist matte grey ceramic tile with a smooth non-glossy finish. Perfect for modern homes and clean interior designs.

title: Outdoor Brick Tile
description: Brick-style clay tile designed for outdoor walls and flooring. It offers a traditional brick appearance with modern durability and strong weather resistance for long-term outdoor use.
